name: Netronome
description: Netronome is a network speed test and monitoring tool with a web interface. It runs Speedtest.net, LibreSpeed and iperf3 tests on demand or on a schedule, watches packet loss and DNS, and collects metrics from agents on your servers.

notes.text: There is no default login: the first visit opens a registration page, and that account is the only one. Create it right after the install.
/api/speedtest/public/history shows your test results without a login. Put a reverse proxy in front before exposing it beyond your LAN.
iperf3 tests need an iperf3 server: run iperf3 -s on another host and add it under Speed Test > iperf3.
